analysis: Staged variable selection and multi-algorithm agroclimatic clustering benchmark
feature_unit: location by selected variable-calendar-month climatological mean over selected years
variable_strategies: AC2 forward selection and backward removal followed by frozen subset

Ward hierarchy.prediction: nearest training-cluster centroid surrogate under Euclidean distance

Average-cosine hierarchy.prediction: nearest training-cluster centroid surrogate under cosine distance

championship.held_out_metric: Euclidean silhouette on common standardised held-out locations
championship.stability_metric: pairwise adjusted Rand index among full-location resampled predictions
championship.tiny_cluster_definition: fewer than max(3, ceil(2% of locations))
championship.quality: harmonic mean of nonnegative held-out silhouette and stability minus tiny-cluster penalty

parsimony_rule.ordering: algorithm complexity rank, then lower k, then higher quality

independent_audit.audit_scope: best searched configuration from every eligible family

pca.selection: smallest component count reaching selected cumulative variance
pca.relationship_to_clustering: independent descriptive dimensionality; clustering uses selected full feature space

scientific_boundary: Exploratory empirical partition conditional on supplied data and candidate methods; not causal discovery, an official agroecological classification, crop-response validation or guaranteed transferability.
